coverage_exempt.reason: Unreachable in the valid-backed synchronous object domain: 0x4b45f0 checks manager+0x78 and immediately invokes unchanged 0x4b4430, whose identical no-callback guard cannot now be false. limits: The volume value entry 0x4b3b90 accepts only signed integers 0 through 100; the exact adapter fails closed for every other word and makes no arbitrary-input math claim.
The original table-fill loop 0x4b3c80 remains owned by audio_manager_lifecycle; its appearance in legacy measurements does not add ownership here.
Existing portable AudioEvents APIs remain reusable; canonical memory transport is a separate source and native joins remain unverified.
Physical audio effects are case-provided virtual methods; resource selection, scalar setters, name lookup and diagnostics remain original game callees rather than fixtures.
The name-map CRT comparison path is bounded to the original single-byte mode at global 0x540e00 equal to zero.
notes: Full existing game-owned audio event surface plus the reviewed bounded volume-value entry; sources retain the portable body selected by the ownership review.
